suggestions.guidance_rule: All employees cannot access other teams' repositories.
suggestions.missing_context: No team-to-repository ownership mapping is available in system_vars.json or search_repos tool arguments. Enforcing this rule requires knowing which team owns each repository and which team the caller belongs to.
suggestions.reason: This rule cannot be enforced without a 'team' field in subject claims and a corresponding repo ownership mapping. Add 'team' to system_vars.json and pass it as a subject claim, then add a repo-to-team mapping to the policy data.

note: These are suggestions for future system variable additions. They are NOT part of the current policy.
